ideas.title: Versioned event schema (pydantic) as the single contract
ideas.why: Every layer validates against one schema; TS types generated from it

ideas.title: Category taxonomy (YAML) with keyword classifier + deprecation
ideas.why: Categories are ids, never free text

ideas.title: Polite HTTP client: robots, per-host rate limit, backoff, conditional GET
ideas.why: Respect sources; cheap polling

ideas.title: SQLite storage with forward-only migrations + raw payload store
ideas.why: Boring, solid, replayable

ideas.title: Per-unit health state machine (healthy/degraded/quarantined/recovering)
ideas.why: Failures are never silent; last-known-good keeps serving

ideas.title: Generic adapters: Socrata, ICS, Tribe Events (WordPress), Localist, LiveWhale
ideas.why: One adapter covers thousands of sites; cities become config

ideas.title: Ticketmaster + SeatGeek adapters (key-gated, report 'needs key' when absent)
ideas.why: Concert prices; stubbed until keys arrive

ideas.title: Entity resolution: venues + cross-source event clustering with sticky ids
ideas.why: Same concert on 5 sites = 1 card with 5 prices

ideas.title: Deadline extraction from free text with evidence
ideas.why: 'register by Oct 3' → registration.closes_at

ideas.title: Attendance estimate with method + band (capacity × fill, or category prior)
ideas.why: Never fake precision

ideas.title: Extract 'Location:'/'Where:' lines from descriptions when venue is missing
ideas.why: MPRB and many calendars put the place only in the body

ideas.title: Keep registration/sign-up links from description HTML as offers (SignUpGenius, Eventbrite, etc.)
ideas.why: 'Sign up here' links are the most actionable thing on a volunteer card

ideas.title: Series collapse: group repeated occurrences into one recurring card with next dates
ideas.why: Feeds list weekly things 8×; list view should show one card

ideas.title: Volunteer opportunities are free by definition (derived, labeled)
ideas.why: Avoid 'price unknown' noise on volunteer cards

ideas.title: Dashboard: Vite + Preact + TS, list/calendar/map/deadlines views
ideas.why: The product people see

ideas.title: New-in-town onboarding → personalized first-30-days plan with explanations
ideas.why: The core 'you're new, here's your first month' promise

ideas.title: Calendar export (.ics) per event and for the whole plan, with VALARM before deadlines
ideas.why: 'Remind me before registration closes' without a backend

ideas.title: Weather badge on outdoor events from NWS api.weather.gov (keyless)
ideas.why: Outdoor plans need forecasts; NWS is free, US-only, perfect fit

ideas.title: New bars/restaurants from fresh liquor-license records (NY SLA, TABC, Chicago, Minneapolis, Seattle)
ideas.why: Openings proxy from real government data, keyless

ideas.title: Curated league registry (YAML) with verified dates + page-watch to detect changes
ideas.why: Beer leagues have no APIs; curated + monitored is the honest path

ideas.title: Meetup GraphQL adapter (OAuth) incl. RSVP counts and attendanceForecast
ideas.why: Run clubs, trivia, social groups; real RSVP numbers

ideas.title: GitHub Actions: hourly refresh, DB persisted via cache + data branch, Pages deploy
ideas.why: It must auto-update

ideas.title: Auto-open a GitHub issue when a unit gets quarantined
ideas.why: Failures loud even when nobody watches the dashboard

ideas.title: Wikidata SPARQL for venue capacities (P1083) with source links
ideas.why: Better attendance estimates from real capacities

ideas.title: Health page in the dashboard (per-source state, last success, SLA, errors)
ideas.why: Observability inside the product

ideas.title: 'Good for meeting people' filter + social score explanations
ideas.why: Newcomers want people, not just events

ideas.title: Shareable links (state in URL) + saved events in localStorage
ideas.why: Share a plan with a friend

ideas.title: Price-drop / selling-fast alerts from snapshots
ideas.why: Needs SeatGeek/TM keys for real signal

ideas.title: Neighborhood 'vibe' summaries computed from event mix
ideas.why: Help pick where to live/hang out

ideas.title: 'Bring a friend' mode: events good for pairs vs. solo
ideas.why: Different social modes for newcomers

ideas.title: Library systems via BiblioCommons RSS (Hennepin, Chicago, Boston)
ideas.why: Free classes, clubs, talks — high-quality keyless data

ideas.title: NYC permitted events (block parties, street fairs) via Socrata
ideas.why: Exactly the 'block party' pitch, keyless

ideas.title: Map view clustering + 'near me' by neighborhood
ideas.why: Distance filter in the pitch

ideas.title: Recorded-fixture adapter tests (tests never hit the internet)
ideas.why: Engineering bar

ideas.title: Freshness SLA per field shown on cards ('checked 2h ago')
ideas.why: Trust

ideas.title: Source reliability score computed from health history
ideas.why: SOURCES.md reliability column from data, not vibes

ideas.title: Season calendar: 'what's registering now' timeline for leagues
ideas.why: Leagues open/close in waves; show the wave

ideas.title: City onboarding checklist (DMV, voter registration, library card, transit pass) as deadlines
ideas.why: Every new resident has the same 10 deadlines; nobody lists them

ideas.title: Eventbrite city-wide search
ideas.why: Eventbrite removed public event search in 2019 (404); only per-organizer/venue access remains

ideas.title: Songkick API
ideas.why: Paid license; no new hobbyist approvals

ideas.title: Bandsintown API
ideas.why: Terms limit use to artists' own data and forbid mixing with other sources without distinction

ideas.title: Resident Advisor scraping
ideas.why: Terms §4.4 ban scraping; undocumented GraphQL

ideas.title: DoStuff network (Do512/Do312) scraping
ideas.why: No API and actively blocks bots — ask for a partnership instead

ideas.title: Yelp Events API
ideas.why: $229+/mo after trial

ideas.title: Showing a precise '% tickets left' from any source
ideas.why: No legit source exposes seat inventory to third parties; we show labeled signals with bands instead

ideas.title: Discover more HandsOn Connect / Galaxy Digital tenants and Volo markets for new cities
ideas.why: HOC/Galaxy pages only list org calendars; Volo, HOC and Galaxy tenants exist in more cities (Volo: DC, Philly, SF, San Diego; HOC tenants findable via cdn0.handsonconnect.org)

ideas.title: Track Volo price steps per program (early bird → regular → last chance) as a price trend
ideas.why: Volo detail /l/{uuid} and the discover card show the same program; a weekly diff of price per player lets us show 'price went up on 10/17' with evidence and alert before early-bird ends

ideas.title: Health check: flag when distinct listing pages return identical record sets (UpcomingCons)
ideas.why: UpcomingCons category pages returned the anime list for /gaming and /sci-fi within one minute; a guard that flags identical listing-id sets across distinct pages catches this server-side caching bug

ideas.title: Email Make: (makerfaire.com) for permission/allowlisting of /query/?type=map
ideas.why: Maker Faire map JSON is keyless and robots-allowed but Cloudflare challenges our client; asking Make: for access (or an export) unblocks the only national faire feed

ideas.title: Dashboard strip: league/volunteer sign-ups closing in the next 7 days
ideas.why: Volo, HOC and Galaxy now give hundreds of shifts/seasons with spots-left and closes_at; a 'closing this week' strip per city is the core 'deadlines you'd otherwise miss' promise

ideas.title: Share one fetch of national pages across city units in a run
ideas.why: Global sources (upcomingcons, makerfaire) refetch identical national pages once per city; a per-run shared payload cache would cut 10x requests

ideas.title: ics: lift Luma 'Get up-to-date information at' link as the event URL/RSVP offer
ideas.why: Luma ICS feeds omit URL; descriptions say 'Get up-to-date information at: https://luma.com/...'; lifting it gives every Luma event an RSVP offer
